podcasts.name: Tech Snippets Today with Joseph Raczynski
podcasts.title: Fixing Financial Plumbing: Jay Heller on the Future of Autonomous Capital Flow
podcasts.description: Every single day, trillions of dollars flow silently beneath the surface of the global economy—moving through governments, central banks, and massive financial institutions. But the underlying plumbing that governs these capital movements was built for a legacy era. What if we didn't need to burn down the existing financial architecture to instantly make it verifiable, compliant, and hyper-efficient? What if an intelligent validation layer could sit right on top of global rails—merging real-time AI compliance with the absolute immutability of blockchain audit trails? Today, we are cracking open the future of institutional payments, digital asset infrastructure, and cross-border capital velocity. We’re examining what happens when traditional capital market rigor meets frontier technology to solve friction at the institutional scale. We are diving deep into the shift from legacy clearing systems to autonomous, real-time transaction verification—and why the next decade of finance isn't about speculation, but structural trust. At long last, let’s bring in Jay to help us understand all of this! Send us Fan Mail Many more amazing technology episodes to come! Subscribe and prepare for the new world.
